## What has to be decided and built

::: {.kicker}
L2 → L3
:::

:::: {.grid-3}
::: {.card .blue}
::: {.label}
Decisions to be made
:::

- Versioned response calibrations
- Will AIA data arrive, and how?
- L3A / L3B / L2.5 as separate products, or HDUs in one file?
:::

::: {.card .amber}
::: {.label}
muse library work first
:::

- Make the filter callable by the pipeline: a method registry, and "not run" instead of exceptions for missing inputs
  - This is a major refactor
- Configuration instead of hard-coded values
  - The pipeline must pin the chosen configuration
:::

::: {.card .green}
::: {.label}
Pipeline work after that
:::

- Level 3 science module, plus reading Level 2 and publishing Level 3
- Level 3 science configuration
- Final test: match the benchmark output to machine precision
- Freeze the agreed L2 → L3 into one fixed sequence
:::
